mostWorthwhile.text: Showing Moth the rejection was most worthwhile: its cached map connected a missing directory entry to advice that would keep deliveries away.

leastWorthwhile.text: Replacing the display ribbon felt rather routine in a straightforward repair sequence, even if the physical details were clear.

surprise.text: Moth's advice to keep vans elsewhere showed how an incomplete map could reinforce the neighborhood's exclusion.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the terminal repairs followed the stated diagnosis, and the speaker insert had a clear purpose.

continue.text: Yes. I'd like to see whether the neighbors can challenge the service gap, although I hope for more meaningful choices than the mostly linear repairs.
